integrity: The all-order result is supported by an analytical autocorrelation proof. A standalone finite checker tests representative cases without replacing the proof. No independent mathematical validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Assumes N=2m with m odd and at least 3, a three-tap flat window, all translations and all modulations, and a coordinatewise nonzero signal.
Does not classify even half-lengths, sparse signals, other tap weights, partial measurements, or stability.
Novelty is a literature-based judgment with residual risk from specialized unindexed earlier results.
title: Complete full-support fibers for the three-tap cyclic Fourier window in odd half-length
